description: This file contains implementation of big number (BIGNUM) conversion functions, including byte array to BIGNUM conversions, endian-specific conversions, and utility functions for handling BIGNUMs in the OpenSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: bn_big_endian_to_words
methods.description: Converts big-endian byte array to array of BN_ULONG words, handling partial words and zero-padding.

methods.name: BN_bin2bn
methods.description: Converts big-endian byte array to BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_le2bn
methods.description: Converts little-endian byte array to BIGNUM.

methods.name: fits_in_bytes
methods.description: Checks if a number of BN_ULONG words can be represented in a given number of bytes.

methods.name: bn_assert_fits_in_bytes
methods.description: Asserts that a BIGNUM fits within a specified byte size.

methods.name: bn_words_to_big_endian
methods.description: Converts array of BN_ULONG words to big-endian byte array, with zero-padding.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin
methods.description: Serializes BIGNUM to big-endian byte array.

methods.name: BN_bn2le_padded
methods.description: Serializes BIGNUM to little-endian byte array with padding.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin_padded
methods.description: Serializes BIGNUM to big-endian byte array with padding.

methods.name: BN_get_word
methods.description: Retrieves the least significant word of a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_get_u64
methods.description: Retrieves the BIGNUM value as a 64-bit unsigned integer if possible.
